root = Stack([title, callout, chartsRow])
title = TextContent("Checkout Page Variants Comparison", "large-heavy")
callout = Callout("success", "Recommendation: Ship Variant D", "Variant D (express pay first) achieved the highest conversion rate (3.9%) and the lowest bounce rate (35%), offsetting the slight dip in Average Order Value.")
chartsRow = Stack([convCard, aovCard, bounceCard], "row", "m", "stretch", "start", true)

convCard = Card([convHeader, convChart])
convHeader = CardHeader("Conversion Rate (%)", "Higher is better")
convChart = BarChart(labels, [convSeries], "grouped")
convSeries = Series("Conversion", [3.1, 3.6, 3.3, 3.9])

aovCard = Card([aovHeader, aovChart])
aovHeader = CardHeader("Average Order Value ($)", "Higher is better")
aovChart = BarChart(labels, [aovSeries], "grouped")
aovSeries = Series("AOV", [54, 51, 56, 49])

bounceCard = Card([bounceHeader, bounceChart])
bounceHeader = CardHeader("Bounce Rate (%)", "Lower is better")
bounceChart = BarChart(labels, [bounceSeries], "grouped")
bounceSeries = Series("Bounce Rate", [41, 37, 40, 35])

labels = ["A (Control)", "B (One-Page)", "C (Trust)", "D (Express)"]
